mentions.name: Hand-plane hardwood slab furniture project
mentions.description: A hands-on woodworking project that uses hand planes to flatten a hardwood slab (and dimensional lumber) milled from a tree felled in the yard, undertaken as an analog escape from AI/digital overload, with the goal of building furniture.
mentions.problem: AI/digital overload motivating an offline, hands-on hobby
mentions.source_excerpt: Having AI/digital overload, I purchased some hand planes and am flatting a hardwood slab (and dimensional) that I had milled from a tree felled in my yard in order to make some furniture.
mentions.author: chromatin
